role: fellow stand-up comedian critiquing a joke or bit posted to a comedy workshop subreddit
input_unit: comment thread under a stand-up joke post
inline_evidence_example: the phrase 'punchline lands too late' is a complaint evidencing 'pacing' norm; 'the setup recycles a tired premise' is a complaint evidencing 'originality' norm; 'great misdirection in line 3' is praise evidencing 'subversion craft' norm
polarity_hint: Comedy workshop comments skew critical-but-constructive (most threads are 70% suggestions, 20% praise, 10% complaints). Reddit-style riffs ('lol same') are NOT signals — extract only substantive judgments.
